text:
emily chen: hey folks :wave: finished unboxing my M1 Air and went through the Kandji setup. Kandji shows the device as 'Enrolled' but two issues: 1) macOS shows a 'System extension blocked' banner and a 'Certificate not trusted' prompt for the VPN cert, and 2) when I try to enable FileVault it errors with 'Recovery key escrow failed'. Also trying to sign into Okta MFA for a few tools and it reports 'device not compliant'. Any quick checks I should run or who to ping? pinging @it-support
it-support: hi emily — welcome! can you confirm which wifi you were on during enrollment (home vs RWD-Corp)? captive portals / corporate cert installs often fail on guest networks. also can you paste the output of:
```
profiles status -type enrollment
sudo fdesetup status
```
also please avoid sharing long serials here — we only need last 4 if we need to look it up
alex liu: +1 to what it-support said. if you were on a personal hotspot or guest wifi the MDM profile likely installed but the CA cert didn't. try reconnecting to RWD-Corp and then open System Settings -> Privacy & Security -> General and click 'Allow' for any system extension prompts. after that, in Kandji app click 'Re-check enrollment'
emily chen: I was on my apartment wifi when I set it up. ran the commands — output:
profiles status -type enrollment: Enrolled to kandji: true, profile com.redwood.mdm present
sudo fdesetup status: FileVault is Off.
Okta still: device not compliant (missing profile com.redwood.security)
maya patel: if the MDM profile is present but Okta flags non-compliant it's often because the cert used for SCEP/CA didn't install correctly. alex — can we push the CA again?
alex liu: we can. emily, before we re-push: reboot once while on RWD-Corp, then do Settings -> Privacy & Security and look for any 'Allow' buttons (system extension/block prompts). if you see an 'Untrusted Certificate' dialog in Safari, try visiting https://kandji.redwood to force cert install (or open the Kandji app). if that still fails send me the last 4 of your serial and i can push a remediation from console
emily chen: rebooted on RWD-Corp, saw two 'Allow' banners and clicked them. Kandji now reports 'Profile complete' but FileVault still errors with 'Escrow attempt failed (network error)'. Okta still shows non-compliant. i've got the last 4 of serial: 4B7C
it-support: ok creating ticket INC-20260312-42 and assigning to endpoint team. earlier escrow failures often fix if the device stays online for ~10-15 minutes while Kandji syncs. in the meantime we can grant you temporary admin to approve the system prompts manually if you're comfortable. that would be a 2-hour temp admin — want us to enable?
emily chen: yes please that would help, i'm blocked on installing a few apps. thanks!
it-support: done — temporary admin window opened for 2 hours. you should see an approval popup, let us know when you finish installing apps. i've added the endpoint team and maya to the ticket. :white_check_mark:
emily chen: gave the approvals, re-ran fdesetup and now it says FileVault is On. Okta shows compliant after a sync. thanks everyone for the quick help :bow:
